description: Add analytics & reporting dashboards to Agora Studio: traffic, latency, cost, and capability-usage across the user's network of AI apps/services. Traffic and latency are aggregated from the same KCS telemetry the message viewer reads (`console/src/kcs/spans.ts`) — depending on `55-kcs-observability-rewrite` (Phase D) so the aggregates are built on the ratified emitted-telemetry shape, never on the provisional `ObservedSpan` shape Phase D replaces; cost reuses the provider-router's existing cost-estimation semantics (the router's cost-estimation / budget-ceiling model — mirrored in the registry's cost ranking `registry/src/cost.ts`) rather than inventing a pricing model; capability-usage is aggregated over the KCB capabilities the discovered participants advertise. Studio remains an observer reading existing surfaces (ADR-0001). Scope: the `studio/` workspace only. agora gates on `make check`.

userStories.title: Traffic and latency dashboards from telemetry
userStories.description: Aggregate the KCS span telemetry into traffic (message volume) and latency dashboards across the network and per connection.
acceptanceCriteria: Studio aggregates the KCS telemetry (`console/src/kcs/spans.ts`, reused by reference) into traffic (message counts/rates) and latency (e.g. distribution/percentiles) views, both network-wide and per connection/edge from the 61 graph
A test feeds a synthetic span set and asserts the aggregates are computed correctly (counts and latency stats), and that an empty telemetry set yields empty dashboards rather than fabricated numbers
`make check` green (`npm run lint` + `npm run typecheck` + `vitest` for `studio/`)

userStories.title: Cost and capability-usage dashboards
userStories.description: Report cost using the router's existing cost-estimation semantics and capability-usage over the KCB capabilities participants advertise — reusing existing surfaces, not a new pricing model.
acceptanceCriteria: A cost dashboard reports spend/estimated cost using the provider-router's existing cost-estimation semantics (mirrored by the registry cost ranking `registry/src/cost.ts`), honoring `unpriced` ≠ free (an unpriced call is shown as unpriced, never as zero), and a capability-usage view aggregates calls by the KCB capability the discovered participants advertise

A test asserts the cost aggregation reuses the router's cost semantics (including the `unpriced` case) and that capability-usage is grouped by advertised capability, not by a hard-wired participant name
`make check` green; Studio invents no new pricing model and relays no traffic (observer-only, ADR-0001)
